units.source_text: 天堂的美梦尚未苏醒之前，秋天早晨的阳光已经洒金了简陋狭小的屋子，留下了丝丝凉意。

en.t: Before the beautiful dream of heaven had yet awakened, the autumn morning sunlight had already gilded the small, shabby room, leaving behind threads of chill.

units.source_text: 但是，挂着布满灰尘的帐子的床还像小船一样，昏暗中残存着一点温暖，

en.t: But the bed, hung with dust-covered curtains, still remained like a little boat, holding a little warmth in the dimness,

units.source_text: 金花仰面躺在昏暗的帐子中，陈旧的看出不原色的毛毯遮住了她圆润的下巴，

en.t: Jinhua lay on her back within the dim curtains, and an old blanket whose original color could no longer be made out covered her rounded chin,

units.source_text: 苍白的脸颊也许是被昨夜的汗水打湿，

en.t: her pale cheeks perhaps dampened by last night's sweat,

units.source_text: 乌黑的秀发零花的贴在脸上，

en.t: her glossy black hair clung in disarray to her face,

units.source_text: 糯米般细白的牙齿在微微开合的双唇间若隐若现。

en.t: and her fine white teeth, like grains of glutinous rice, flickered in and out between her lips as they opened and closed slightly.
